title: pendulluma procumbens
intro: Pendulluma procumbens, commonly known as Indian sandalwood, is a plant species native to India that has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Pendulluma procumbens include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote a sense of well-being, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, such as alpha-santalol, which are responsible for its distinct fragrance and medicinal properties.
